name: Melanotan II

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A cyclic heptapeptide analogue of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone acting non-selectively across melanocortin receptors. It has no approval anywhere; the related selective agonists afamelanotide and bremelanotide are separately approved products and are not this compound. No FDA approval in any jurisdiction. Distinct from the approved products afamelanotide (Scenesse) and bremelanotide (Vyleesi).

systems.note: Taken for melanogenesis and pigmentation via MC1R; the intended effect.
Non-selective melanocortin agonism raises blood pressure; described for the class.
Rhabdomyolysis has been reported in the case literature.
Nausea, flushing and MC4R-mediated central effects are characteristic.

monitors.why: Rhabdomyolysis case reports; renal injury is the specific concern.
Rhabdomyolysis is the reported serious adverse event.
